name: mcp__aws-core-mcp-server__list_aws_instances
description: Retrieves a list of EC2 instances within a specified AWS region, filtered by optional state (e.g., running, stopped) or instance type. It accepts region_name and filters as inputs to narrow down the results.

name: mcp__aws-core-mcp-server__describe_ec2_instance
description: Fetches detailed metadata for a specific EC2 instance given its instance ID, including network interfaces, launch time, and block device mappings. The primary input is the instance_id required to identify the target resource.

name: mcp__aws-core-mcp-server__get_s3_bucket_lifecycle
description: Returns the lifecycle configuration rules for a specified S3 bucket, detailing how objects are transitioned or expired over time. It requires the bucket_name as an input to query the associated policy.

name: mcp__aws-core-mcp-server__list_cloudwatch_logs
description: Lists log groups or recent log events from AWS CloudWatch Logs for a specified service or prefix, optionally filtered by time range. Inputs include log_group_name and start_time/end_time to define the scope of the query.

name: mcp__aws-core-mcp-server__get_iam_user_permissions
description: Returns the IAM policies attached to a specific user or group, listing allowed and denied actions for identity access management analysis. The tool takes user_name or group_name as inputs to retrieve the associated policy documents.

name: mcp__aws-core-mcp-server__list_ecr_repositories
description: Lists all Elastic Container Registry (ECR) repositories in a specified AWS region, including their URIs and creation dates. It accepts region_name as an input to filter the registry resources displayed.

name: mcp__aws-diagram__generate_aws_diagram
description: Generates an AWS architecture diagram by compiling Python DSL code that defines AWS resources and their connections. It accepts the Python source string as input to render a visual representation of the infrastructure.

name: mcp__aws-diagram__generate_sequence_diagram
description: Creates sequence diagrams based on provided Python DSL code describing interactions between system components or objects. The main input is the Python code defining the timeline and messages of the interaction flow.

name: mcp__aws-diagram__generate_flow_diagram
description: Produces a standard process or logic flow diagram using Python DSL code that specifies nodes, edges, and directional flows. It takes the descriptive Python script as input to visualize the sequence of steps or decision points.

name: mcp__aws-diagram__generate_class_diagram
description: Constructs a UML class diagram from Python DSL code that defines classes, attributes, methods, and their relationships. The tool accepts the Python source defining the class structure to render the object-oriented design visually.

name: mcp__aws-healthomics__create_workflow_template
description: Generates a new AWS HealthOmics workflow template from a specification or existing definition. Accepts the workflow name, type (e.g., sequencing), and an optional description to initialize the container for your lifescience processes.

name: mcp__aws-healthomics__get_workflow_template
description: Retrieves the detailed configuration of an existing AWS HealthOmics workflow template by its unique ID. Useful for inspecting the current state or parameters before attempting to run a job.

name: mcp__aws-healthomics__run_workflow
description: Initiates the execution of a specific AWS HealthOmics workflow template using provided input arguments and role permissions. Returns a job identifier that can be used to track the status of the running lifescience process.

name: mcp__aws-healthomics__get_workflow_job
description: Fetches the current status, logs, and output location of a specific workflow job by its unique ID. Essential for monitoring progress or diagnosing issues during the execution phase.

name: mcp__aws-healthomics__list_workflow_jobs
description: Lists the metadata of workflow jobs associated with a specific template ID, filtered by status (e.g., RUNNING, SUCCEEDED, FAILED) and date range. Helps in debugging by providing an overview of recent job activities.

name: mcp__aws-healthomics__delete_workflow_template
description: Permanently removes an AWS HealthOmics workflow template from your account after confirming it is not currently running active jobs. Requires the unique template ID as its primary input to prevent accidental deletion of unused definitions.

name: mcp__aws-iot-sitewise__batch_get_asset_property
description: Retrieves the current or historical values for one or more asset properties from AWS IoT SiteWise. It accepts an asset property identifier list and optional time range parameters to fetch specific data points.

name: mcp__aws-iot-sitewise__list_assets
description: Lists all assets visible in the specified AWS Region within your AWS account, optionally filtered by a parent asset ID or hierarchical path. It supports pagination to handle large volumes of industrial assets efficiently.

name: mcp__aws-iot-sitewise__create_asset
description: Creates a new asset in your AWS IoT SiteWise monitor with a unique identifier and specified property definitions for industrial equipment. It requires the asset name, optional parent ID for hierarchy, and metadata describing the asset's characteristics.

name: mcp__aws-iot-sitewise__get_asset_hierarchy
description: Retrieves the hierarchical structure of assets or components associated with a specific parent asset to understand the industrial site layout. It returns a list of child nodes along with their IDs, names, and types within the asset model.

name: mcp__aws-iot-sitewise__put_asset_property_value
description: Updates the current value of a specific asset property in AWS IoT SiteWise to reflect real-time industrial data. It takes the asset identifier, property alias or ID, and the new timestamped value to ingest.

name: mcp__aws-kb-retrieval-server__retrieve_from_knowledge_base
description: Retrieves relevant information from a specified AWS Knowledge Base using natural language queries via the Bedrock Agent Runtime. It accepts the knowledge base ID and the user's query text as inputs.

name: mcp__aws-kb-retrieval-server__list_knowledge_bases
description: Lists the available AWS Knowledge Bases that can be queried, filtering by status or other optional criteria. It helps users identify valid knowledgeBaseId values for subsequent retrieval operations.

name: mcp__aws-kb-retrieval-server__get_knowledge_base_details
description: Fetches metadata and configuration details for a specific AWS Knowledge Base identified by its ID. This tool provides necessary context such as the associated data source types and status to ensure correct usage.

name: mcp__aws-msk__describe_msk_cluster
description: Retrieves detailed configuration and status information for a specific Amazon MSK cluster using its ARN. Inputs: cluster_arn.

name: mcp__aws-msk__list_msk_clusters
description: Returns a list of Amazon MSK clusters within the specified AWS region, including their names and creation timestamps. Inputs: optional marker for pagination and max_results limit.

name: mcp__aws-msk__create_msk_cluster
description: Provisions a new managed Apache Kafka cluster in Amazon MSK with specified node counts, instance types, and encryption settings. Inputs: cluster_name, broker_node_group_config, kafka_version, and storage configuration parameters.

name: mcp__aws-pricing__get_service_pricing
description: Retrieves the current on-demand pricing details for a specific AWS service or product. It requires the AWS Service Code (e.g., 'AmazonEC2') and optionally a Product Filter (e.g., 'On Demand Instance') to narrow down the results.

name: mcp__aws-pricing__get_pricing_file
description: Returns the metadata for available JSON pricing files (such as On-Demand, Reserved, or Spot instances) that can be downloaded for bulk analysis. It takes no inputs or optionally accepts a filter for file types to list all available billing report structures.

name: mcp__aws-pricing__estimate_ec2_cost
description: Calculates the estimated hourly and monthly cost for an Amazon EC2 instance based on specific configuration parameters. Inputs include the instance type, operating system region, tenancy, and whether it is On-Demand, Reserved, or Spot pricing.

name: mcp__aws-pricing__estimate_s3_cost
description: Provides a cost estimate for Amazon S3 storage based on storage class, volume size, and region. Required inputs include the storage class (e.g., Standard, Infrequent Access) and the total storage volume in bytes.

name: mcp__aws-pricing__get_supported_regions
description: Lists the AWS regions where specific pricing data is available or services can be purchased. It typically takes a Service Code as input to verify regional availability and pricing support for that service.

name: mcp__aws-pricing__compare_instance_pricing
description: Compares cost estimates across different instance types, operating systems, or purchasing options (On-Demand vs. Reserved) within a specific AWS region. Inputs generally include the target service code, region, and a list of instance identifiers to compare.

name: mcp__aws-terraform__validate_terraform_code
description: Analyzes Terraform configuration files for syntax errors and structural issues before execution. It accepts the root directory of the Terraform project as input.

name: mcp__aws-terraform__run_security_scan
description: Executes Checkov to scan infrastructure-as-code files for security vulnerabilities and compliance violations against AWS best practices. It requires the path to the Terraform configuration or directory as its primary input.

name: mcp__aws-terraform__generate_infrastructure_plan
description: Creates an execution plan for applying changes to AWS infrastructure based on the current state and desired configuration in the codebase. It takes the Terraform workspace name and variable values as optional inputs to customize the plan.

name: mcp__awslabs-ccapi__cloud_control_search_resources
description: Searches for AWS resources of a specified type (e.g., EC2 instances, S3 buckets) using Cloud Control API pagination to handle large result sets. It accepts a ResourceType ARN and optional filters like Identifier or StatusCode to narrow the scope of the search.

name: mcp__awslabs-ccapi__cloud_control_create_resource
description: Initiates the creation of a new AWS resource defined by a CloudFormation template snippet or JSON schema. The tool requires the ResourceType ARN, the TypeConfig (schema definition), and ResourceProperties containing the configuration values for the new instance.

name: mcp__awslabs-ccapi__cloud_control_read_resource
description: Retrieves the current state and properties of an existing AWS resource using its unique identifier. It takes the ResourceType ARN and the Identifier (such as the Resource ID) as inputs to fetch the detailed JSON response from the Cloud Control API.

name: mcp__awslabs-ccapi__cloud_control_update_resource
description: Updates an existing AWS resource with new properties or configurations without destroying it. This tool requires the ResourceType ARN, the Resource Identifier, and a set of updated ResourceProperties to apply changes incrementally.

name: mcp__awslabs-ccapi__cloud_control_delete_resource
description: Deletes an existing AWS resource based on its type and unique identifier, handling the lifecycle termination. It accepts the ResourceType ARN and the Resource Identifier as inputs and may optionally take a ClientRequestToken for idempotency.

name: mcp__awslabs-cfn__cloudformation_create_stack
description: Creates a new AWS CloudFormation stack by executing a create operation via the Cloud Control API. It takes the stack name, an optional change set configuration, and a JSON/YAML formatted template body as primary inputs.

name: mcp__awslabs-cfn__cloudformation_update_stack
description: Updates an existing AWS CloudFormation stack to reflect changes in its template or parameters using the Cloud Control API. It requires the target stack name and either a new template body, updated parameter values, or both as inputs.

name: mcp__awslabs-cfn__cloudformation_delete_stack
description: Deletes an existing AWS CloudFormation stack by initiating a delete operation through the Cloud Control API. It primarily takes the identifier (stack name or ID) of the target stack as its main input.

name: mcp__awslabs-cfn__cloudformation_describe_stack
description: Describes the details and current status of a specific AWS CloudFormation stack via the Cloud Control API. It requires the identifier (stack name or ID) of the stack to retrieve information such as its creation time, parameters, and resource list.

name: mcp__awslabs-cloudtrail__describe_trail
description: Retrieves details about a specific AWS CloudTrail trail, including its configuration and status. The main input is the name of the trail to describe.

name: mcp__awslabs-cloudtrail__list_trails
description: Lists all CloudTrail trails defined in the current account or region. No inputs are required for this operation.

name: mcp__awslabs-cloudtrail__get_insight_results
description: Retrieves findings from CloudTrail Insights, which detects anomalous API activity. The main inputs are the Insight ID and the type of result (e.g., 'Findings').

name: mcp__awslabs-cloudtrail__lookup_event
description: Searches for specific events in a trail’s log files based on criteria such as event name or resource type. The main inputs are the search criteria and the list of trails to query.

name: mcp__awslabs-cloudtrail__get_trail_status
description: Returns the current status of one or more trails, indicating whether they are logging events. The main input is the name(s) of the trail(s) to check.

name: mcp__awslabs-cloudwatch__get_cloudwatch_metrics
description: Retrieves metric data points for specified Amazon CloudWatch metrics within a given time range and namespace, allowing you to analyze performance trends by filtering on dimensions such as instance ID or region.

name: mcp__awslabs-cloudwatch__put_cloudwatch_alarm
description: Creates or updates an Amazon CloudWatch alarm that monitors a specific metric or math expression, triggering actions like SNS notifications when the metric breaches a defined threshold over a set period.

name: mcp__awslabs-cloudwatch__get_cloudwatch_log_events
description: Fetches log events from specified Amazon CloudWatch Logs groups and streams, supporting filters for time ranges, patterns, or specific log IDs to assist in debugging and analyzing application behavior.

name: mcp__awslabs-cloudwatch-appsignals__get_traces
description: Retrieves detailed trace data for specific requests to help diagnose latency and errors within your application.

name: mcp__awslabs-cloudwatch-appsignals__get_aggregated_service_summary
description: Fetches high-level performance metrics and health status for a service, providing an overview of its operational state.

name: mcp__awslabs-cloudwatch-appsignals__list_anomaly_detectors
description: Lists all configured anomaly detectors to identify automatic baseline deviations in your application's metrics.

name: mcp__awslabs-cloudwatch-appsignals__get_service_map
description: Retrieves a map of services and their dependencies to visualize how requests flow across your architecture.

name: mcp__awslabs-cost-explorer__get_cost_and_usage
description: Retrieves detailed cost and usage data for your AWS account within a specified time period using the Cost Explorer API.

name: mcp__awslabs-cost-explorer__get_reservation_coverage
description: Returns information about your Reserved Instance (RI) coverage, helping you understand how much of your EC2 and RDS costs are covered by existing reservations.

name: mcp__awslabs-cost-explorer__get_savings_plan_coverage
description: Retrieves savings plan coverage data to show what portion of your compute usage is covered by your active savings plans.

name: mcp__awslabs-cost-explorer__get_reservation_purchase_recommendation
description: Provides recommendations for purchasing new Reserved Instances or Savings Plans based on your historical usage patterns and projected costs.

name: mcp__awslabs-dynamodb__describe_table
description: Retrieves metadata and configuration details for a specific DynamoDB table, such as its primary key schema, status, and provisioned throughput settings, using the table name as input.

name: mcp__awslabs-dynamodb__put_item
description: Adds a new item to an existing DynamoDB table by accepting a JSON object representing the item's attributes and values, along with the target table name and optional conditional expressions.

name: mcp__awslabs-dynamodb__get_item
description: Fetches a single item from a DynamoDB table based on its primary key (partition key and sort key) and returns the corresponding attribute values as a JSON object.

name: mcp__awslabs-dynamodb__scan_table
description: Reads items from a DynamoDB table by iterating through all or part of the data, allowing for optional filter expressions to narrow down the results based on specific attribute values.

name: mcp__awslabs-elasticache__describe_cache_clusters
description: Retrieves detailed information about one or more Amazon ElastiCache replication groups or cache clusters, including their status, configuration, and node details. It accepts optional filters such as ReplicationGroupId, CacheClusterId, or MaxRecords to narrow the results.

name: mcp__awslabs-elasticache__describe_cache_parameter_groups
description: Returns a list of cache parameter groups available in the account, including default and custom groups, along with their descriptions and associated node families. It accepts optional filters like ParameterGroupFamily or MaxRecords to limit the returned results.

name: mcp__awslabs-elasticache__describe_cache_subnet_groups
description: Provides detailed information about one or more Amazon ElastiCache subnet groups, including their names and the subnets associated with each group. It accepts optional parameters such as CacheSubnetGroupName to filter the results for a specific subnet group.

name: mcp__awslabs-elasticache__describe_engine_versions
description: Lists the available engine versions for Amazon ElastiCache, including details about supported cache engines and their compatibility. It accepts optional filters like CacheClusterId or CacheParameterGroupFamily to identify specific engine capabilities or versions.

name: mcp__awslabs-iam__create_iam_user
description: Creates a new IAM user with the specified username and optional path. The main input is the `user_name` string, which uniquely identifies the new identity within the AWS account.

name: mcp__awslabs-iam__get_iam_role
description: Retrieves detailed information about an existing IAM role, including its trust policy and attached permissions. The primary input is the `role_name` string used to identify the specific role.

name: mcp__awslabs-iam__list_iam_groups
description: Lists all IAM groups in the AWS account or filters them by a specified path prefix for easier navigation. The main input is an optional `path_prefix` string that narrows down the results based on group structure.

name: mcp__awslabs-iam__attach_policy_to_role
description: Attaches a managed IAM policy to a specific IAM role, granting the permissions defined in that policy. The inputs include the `role_name` where the policy will be attached and the `policy_arn` of the policy.

name: mcp__awslabs-iam__get_iam_user_policies
description: Lists all inline policies directly embedded within a specific IAM user's configuration. The main input is the `user_name` string identifying the target IAM user whose policies are being queried.

name: mcp__awslabs-iam__delete_iam_group
description: Deletes an empty IAM group, requiring that all members be removed from it before deletion can proceed. The primary input is the `group_name` string specifying which group to remove.

name: mcp__awslabs-memcached__create_cache_cluster
description: Creates a new Amazon ElastiCache Memcached cluster with specified node types and availability zones to serve as a high-speed caching layer for your application data.

name: mcp__awslabs-memcached__describe_cache_clusters
description: Returns details about one or more existing Memcached clusters, including their configuration, status, and endpoint information, allowing you to monitor or verify the state of your cache infrastructure.

name: mcp__awslabs-memcached__delete_cache_cluster
description: Deletes an existing Memcached cluster after optionally taking a final snapshot, ensuring that cached data is preserved if needed before removing the resource from your AWS account.

name: mcp__awslabs-nova-canvas__generate_image
description: Generates a high-quality image from a text prompt using the Amazon Nova Canvas model. The tool takes a text prompt as its main input and returns the URL or base64-encoded data of the generated image.

name: mcp__awslabs-nova-canvas__edit_image
description: Modifies an existing image based on a text instruction, such as changing colors, adding objects, or altering style. The tool requires the original image and a descriptive prompt for the desired edits as inputs.

name: mcp__awslabs-nova-canvas__vary_image
description: Creates variations of an input image by applying subtle stylistic or compositional changes while preserving the core subject. The tool takes the original image as input and returns multiple variant outputs.

name: mcp__awslabs-redshift__redshift_execute_query
description: Executes a SQL query against an Amazon Redshift data warehouse. It accepts the database name, schema, and the raw SQL statement as inputs, returning the result set or execution status.

name: mcp__awslabs-redshift__redshift_get_table_schema
description: Retrieves the metadata and column definitions for a specific table in Redshift. It requires the table name and optionally the schema or database name to identify the target object.

name: mcp__awslabs-redshift__redshift_list_tables
description: Lists all available tables within a specified schema or database in the Redshift cluster. The main inputs are the database name and schema name to filter the returned list of table names.

name: mcp__awslabs-redshift__redshift_describe_cluster
description: Provides metadata about the Amazon Redshift cluster, including its status, node type, and endpoint information. It takes no required inputs other than implicit connection configuration.

name: mcp__awslabs-redshift__redshift_copy_to_s3
description: Exports query results or a table's data to an Amazon S3 bucket in specified formats like CSV or Parquet. It requires the SQL query or table name, the S3 destination path, and IAM role ARN as inputs.

name: mcp__awslabs-s3-tables__create_s3_table
description: Creates a new S3 Table with a specified name, database identifier, and data format configuration. It initializes the table schema and prepares it for incoming analytics data.

name: mcp__awslabs-s3-tables__describe_s3_table
description: Retrieves metadata and current configuration details for an existing S3 Table, including its status, ARN, and schema definition. This tool allows users to verify the table's setup and state without modifying it.

name: mcp__awslabs-s3-tables__list_s3_tables
description: Lists all S3 Tables available in a specified database or AWS account, providing their names, statuses, and creation timestamps. It helps users inventory existing tables for analytics workflows.

name: mcp__awslabs-s3-tables__delete_s3_table
description: Permanently removes an existing S3 Table and all associated data from the system. This action requires the table name as input and is typically used to clean up unused resources.

name: mcp__awslabs-s3-tables__get_s3_table_query_results
description: Executes a SQL query against a specific S3 Table and returns the resulting dataset for analytics processing. It takes the table identifier and the SQL statement as primary inputs.

name: mcp__awslabs-s3-tables__update_s3_table_configuration
description: Updates specific configuration parameters of an existing S3 Table, such as its data format or storage settings. It requires the table name and a JSON object containing the new configuration values.

name: mcp__awslabs-timestream-for-influxdb__write_timestream_records
description: Writes time-series data records to a specified Amazon Timestream for InfluxDB database and table, including timestamp and metric values.

name: mcp__awslabs-timestream-for-influxdb__query_timestream_data
description: Executes an InfluxQL query against the Amazon Timestream for InfluxDB instance to retrieve time-series data based on specified filters and aggregations.

name: mcp__awslabs-timestream-for-influxdb__create_timestream_database
description: Creates a new Amazon Timestream for InfluxDB database within the associated cluster to organize and isolate time-series data sets.

name: mcp__awslabs-valkey__describe_cache_clusters
description: Retrieves detailed information about Amazon ElastiCache or MemoryDB for Valkey cache clusters within a specific AWS region. It accepts optional filters for cluster status, node type, or cluster ID to narrow down the results.

name: mcp__awslabs-valkey__get_replication_group
description: Fetches the configuration and current state of a specific MemoryDB for Valkey replication group, including all member nodes. The primary input is the replication group name, with an optional parameter to include subnet or security group details.

name: mcp__awslabs-valkey__execute_valkey_command
description: Executes a valid Valkey command against a specified endpoint of an ElastiCache or MemoryDB for Valkey cluster. It requires the target node endpoint and the specific Valkey command string (e.g., GET, SET, HGETALL) along with its arguments.

name: mcp__awslabs-valkey__list_database_shards
description: Returns a list of database shards within a MemoryDB for Valkey replication group, providing details such as shard status and node endpoints. It takes the replication group name as input and can filter by specific shard IDs.

name: mcp__awslabs-valkey__describe_snapshots
description: Lists available snapshots (backups) for an ElastiCache or MemoryDB for Valkey cluster to aid in data recovery or migration. It accepts the cluster identifier and optional filters for snapshot creation time or status.

name: mcp__beagle-security__get_vulnerabilities
description: Retrieves a list of vulnerabilities detected in applications across specific environments by querying the Beagle Security backend for current threat data.

name: mcp__beagle-security__run_security_scan
description: Triggers an automated security test against a specified application or API to identify new issues and update the vulnerability tracking dashboard.

name: mcp__beagle-security__list_managed_apps
description: Returns a comprehensive list of applications currently managed by the Beagle Security backend for the authenticated user, including their status and configuration details.

name: mcp__beagle-security__get_vulnerability_details
description: Fetches detailed intelligence and context for a specific vulnerability ID, providing information on severity, affected components, and recommended remediation steps.

name: mcp__beagle-security__track_vuln_status
description: Updates or queries the lifecycle status of a specific vulnerability, allowing users to mark issues as acknowledged, fixed, or ignored across different environments.

name: mcp__brave__web_search
description: Performs a web search using the Brave Search API to retrieve relevant page results based on the provided query string and optional filters like number of results or region.

name: mcp__brave__image_search
description: Searches for images via the Brave Search API, returning image metadata such as thumbnails and source URLs based on a text query and optional size or aspect ratio parameters.

name: mcp__brave__news_search
description: Retrieves recent news articles using the Brave Search API, allowing the user to filter by freshness (e.g., past day or week) and retrieve headline, snippet, and URL details for specific queries.

name: mcp__brightdata__search_web
description: Performs a real-time search query across the web to retrieve relevant results and snippets, allowing the AI assistant to discover current information from public sources without relying on outdated cached data.

name: mcp__brightdata__crawl_url
description: Navigates to a specified URL and extracts the complete HTML content of the webpage, handling navigation and dynamic rendering to ensure accessible data extraction even for complex sites.

name: mcp__brightdata__extract_structured_data
description: Analyzes the content of a given webpage or URL to identify and retrieve specific structured insights or data points based on user-defined parameters, converting unstructured web pages into usable formats.

name: mcp__brightdata__bypass_blockers
description: Executes web requests using Bright Data's proxy infrastructure to automatically handle anti-bot measures, CAPTCHAs, and rate limits, ensuring successful access to websites that typically block standard AI scraping attempts.

name: mcp__brightdata__get_website_metadata
description: Retrieves high-level metadata about a specific website or URL, such as title, description, and key structural information, providing a quick overview without needing to download the full page content.

name: mcp__camunda__query_process_instances
description: Executes queries against the Camunda Process Engine to retrieve details about active or historic process instances based on specific filters like process definition key, state, or start time.

name: mcp__camunda__start_process_instance
description: Triggers the creation of a new process instance by providing the process definition key and optional business variables to initialize the workflow with the required data.

name: mcp__camunda__complete_user_task
description: Marks a user task as completed in the engine, allowing the workflow to proceed to the next step, along with any output variables or comments generated by the user.

name: mcp__camunda__get_task_details
description: Retrieves comprehensive metadata and assigned data for a specific user task identified by its ID, including the assignee, form fields, and linked process instance information.

name: mcp__camunda__query_process_definitions
description: Searches for deployed BPMN or CMMN process definitions matching specified criteria such as name, version, or category to identify available workflow templates.

name: mcp__carbon-voice__record_voice_message
description: Initiates a recording session to capture an asynchronous voice message, allowing the user to send audio input directly within the chat interface.

name: mcp__carbon-voice__get_transcription
description: Retrieves the text transcript for a specific voice message by processing the recorded audio through AI transcription services.

name: mcp__carbon-voice__get_summary
description: Generates a concise summary of the content within a specified voice message to provide quick insights without listening to the full recording.

name: mcp__carbon-voice__extract_action_items
description: Analyzes the text or audio of a voice message to automatically identify and list any tasks, deadlines, or commitments mentioned by the speaker.

name: mcp__carbon-voice__list_voice_history
description: Returns a chronological log of recent voice messages exchanged in the current conversation or session for easy reference.

name: mcp__carbon-voice__reply_with_voice
description: Allows the user to send an asynchronous voice response to the most recent message, triggering automatic transcription and action item extraction upon sending.

name: mcp__charmhealth-mcp-server__get_patient_records
description: Retrieves comprehensive patient records based on a specified patient identifier or search criteria, allowing the LLM to access historical health data.

name: mcp__charmhealth-mcp-server__list_encounters
description: Lists past or upcoming medical encounters for a specific patient, typically requiring a patient ID and optional date range filters as inputs.

name: mcp__charmhealth-mcp-server__get_practice_info
description: Fetches current practice information such as staff details, location data, or scheduling policies to provide context for clinical decisions.

name: mcp__circleci__get_pipeline_status
description: Retrieves the current status, duration, and summary of a specific CircleCI pipeline run or workflow. Main inputs include the project name/ID and the pipeline ID.

name: mcp__circleci__fetch_job_logs
description: Extracts the raw output logs from a specific job within a pipeline to diagnose build failures, test errors, or deployment issues. Main inputs are the pipeline ID, workflow ID, and job ID.

name: mcp__circleci__list_recent_jobs
description: Provides a list of recent jobs for a given project, including their statuses, timestamps, and associated commit details to help trace historical changes. Main input is the project name or slug.

name: mcp__circleci__identify_flaky_tests
description: Analyzes historical test data to detect tests with inconsistent pass/fail rates across multiple pipeline runs in a specific workflow. Main inputs include the workflow ID and time range parameters.

name: mcp__circleci__get_workflow_details
description: Returns detailed metadata about a specific workflow, including its jobs, triggers, and configuration, to understand execution context. Main inputs are the project name/ID and the workflow ID.

name: mcp__circleci__answer_cicd_question
description: Uses natural language processing to answer general questions about CircleCI configuration, best practices, or specific error explanations based on provided context. Main inputs include the user's question and optional context like config file content or error logs.

name: mcp__close__send_sales_email
description: Initiates an outbound email to a contact or prospect within the CRM system. It takes the recipient's email address, subject line, and message body as inputs.

name: mcp__close__log_phone_call

description: Converts an audio file into a transcript and formats that transcript as Markdown. It requires the path to the audio file as input.

name: mcp__markitdown__convert_markitdown
description: Converts a specified file or document into Markdown format for easier reading and processing by LLMs. It takes the file path as input and outputs the textual content of the document.

name: mcp__markitdown__get_supported_formats
description: Returns a list of file extensions and MIME types that MarkItDown supports for conversion. This helps determine if a specific file type can be processed before attempting conversion.

name: mcp__markitdown__convert_markdown_to_html
description: Converts provided Markdown text into HTML format. The tool takes raw Markdown string input and outputs the corresponding HTML structure, useful for rendering in web contexts.

name: mcp__markitdown__analyze_file_metadata
description: Extracts metadata from a specified file before conversion, such as author, creation date, or document title. It accepts the file path as input and returns key-value pairs of relevant document properties.

name: mcp__markitdown__check_markitdown_availability
description: Verifies if the MarkItDown library is correctly installed and available in the current environment. This tool ensures the server is ready to handle conversion requests without failing due to missing dependencies.

name: mcp__maven-tools-mcp__maven_tools_search_dependencies
description: Searches Maven Central Repository for dependencies that match specific keywords, group IDs, or artifact names. It returns a list of matching artifacts with their current versions and metadata to help identify available libraries.

name: mcp__maven-tools-mcp__maven_tools_resolve_latest_version
description: Finds the latest stable release version for a given Maven artifact ID and group ID. The main inputs are the group ID and artifact ID, allowing developers to quickly determine the most recent version available in Maven Central.

name: mcp__maven-tools-mcp__maven_tools_get_dependency_details
description: Retrieves detailed metadata for a specific Maven dependency, including its POM XML structure, dependencies list, licenses, and documentation URLs. The inputs are the group ID, artifact ID, and optional version to provide comprehensive information about the library.

name: mcp__maven-tools-mcp__maven_tools_find_transitive_dependencies
description: Identifies the transitive dependencies for a specified direct dependency to help manage conflicts or understand the full dependency tree. The main inputs are the group ID, artifact ID, and version of the primary dependency.

name: mcp__maven-tools-mcp__context7_resolve_version_conflicts
description: Analyzes potential version conflicts between multiple dependencies by comparing their transitive dependency trees. It takes a list of candidate artifacts with versions as input and highlights incompatible libraries or overlapping dependencies.

name: mcp__maven-tools-mcp__context7_get_upgrade_guidance
description: Provides documentation and migration guidance for upgrading a specific library to a newer version, including breaking changes and new features. The inputs are the current group ID, artifact ID, and target version to fetch relevant upgrade notes from Maven Central metadata.

name: mcp__mcp-api-gateway__list_docker_configs
description: Retrieves a list of all available API Gateway configurations currently managed by the server to identify target integrations. It returns metadata such as configuration names, associated API endpoints, and current status.

name: mcp__mcp-api-gateway__invoke_api
description: Executes an HTTP request to a configured API endpoint defined in the Docker-based gateway setup using specified method and parameters. Inputs include the configuration name, HTTP method, URL path, headers, and optional request body.

name: mcp__mcp-api-gateway__get_config_details
description: Fetches detailed information about a specific API Gateway configuration, including its Docker compose context and environment variables. The main input is the unique name or ID of the configuration to inspect.

name: mcp__mcp-api-gateway__update_config
description: Updates an existing API Gateway configuration by modifying its Docker settings or environment variables without requiring a full redeploy. Inputs include the configuration name and a set of updated parameters such as port mappings, service definitions, or secret values.

name: mcp__mcp-code-interpreter__execute_python_code
description: Executes a provided Python code snippet within the persistent Jupyter-like environment, returning standard output and any errors. Main inputs include 'code' (the string of Python code to run) and optional 'variables' to pass initial state from previous sessions.

name: mcp__mcp-code-interpreter__get_variables
description: Retrieves the current state of all preserved variables, imports, and results maintained in the kernel session. Main input is an optional 'variable_name' parameter to filter the returned dictionary of keys and their last known values.

name: mcp__mcp-code-interpreter__reset_environment
description: Clears all previously stored state, including variables, imports, and execution history, effectively restarting the notebook kernel. Main input is an optional 'confirm' boolean to prevent accidental data loss, defaulting to false.

name: mcp__mcp-code-interpreter__list_execution_history
description: Returns a list of previously executed code snippets along with their status (success or error) and output size. Main input is an optional 'limit' integer to specify the number of most recent entries to retrieve, defaulting to 10.

name: mcp__mcp-discord__get_channel_messages
description: Retrieves recent messages from a specified Discord text channel or thread to allow Claude Code to review conversation history, code snippets, or context relevant to development tasks.

name: mcp__mcp-discord__send_message
description: Sends a new message to a specified Discord text channel, enabling the agent to post status updates, log output artifacts, or respond to questions in real-time during CI/CD workflows.

name: mcp__mcp-discord__get_channel_info
description: Retrieves metadata for a specific Discord text channel, such as its name, topic, and ID, helping the agent identify the correct target channel for communication without guessing identifiers.

name: mcp__mcp-github-pr-issue-analyser__get_pull_request_details
description: Fetches comprehensive details for a specific GitHub Pull Request, including its title, body, status, and metadata. It requires the repository full name and the pull request number as inputs.

name: mcp__mcp-github-pr-issue-analyser__analyze_pr_diffs
description: Retrieves and analyzes the code changes (diffs) within a specified Pull Request to identify modifications, additions, or deletions. The tool takes the repository full name and pull request number to fetch the relevant diff data.

name: mcp__mcp-github-pr-issue-analyser__manage_issues
description: Creates, updates, or closes GitHub Issues within a specified repository based on provided parameters. It accepts inputs such as the repository full name, issue title, body content, and an action (create/update/close) along with an optional issue ID.

name: mcp__mcp-github-pr-issue-analyser__handle_releases
description: Triggers or retrieves information about GitHub Releases for a specific repository. It requires the repository full name and can accept inputs like the tag name, release title, and target commit SHA to manage the release lifecycle.

name: mcp__mcp-hackernews__get_top_stories
description: Retrieves a list of the current top stories from Hacker News based on specified criteria such as the story type (e.g., best, new, or ask stories) and the number of items to return.

name: mcp__mcp-hackernews__get_story_details
description: Fetches detailed information about a specific Hacker News story, including its title, URL, score, comment count, and author, using the story's unique ID as input.

name: mcp__mcp-hackernews__get_comments_by_item
description: Retrieves all comments associated with a specific story or item by ID, optionally allowing for pagination to handle large comment threads efficiently.

name: mcp__mcp-hackernews__get_user_profile
description: Fetches public profile information for a specified Hacker News user, including their karma score, creation date, and submitted items.

name: mcp__mcp-python-refactoring__suggest_python_refactors
description: Analyzes a provided Python code snippet or file content to identify specific opportunities for improvement and generates actionable refactoring suggestions. Main inputs include the source code string and an optional context parameter specifying the desired coding style or performance goals.

name: mcp__mcp-python-refactoring__generate_refactored_code
description: Takes a specific refactoring suggestion ID or a detailed description of the desired change and outputs the fully implemented, corrected Python code block. Main inputs include the original code context and the precise transformation instructions derived from prior analysis.

name: mcp__mcp-python-refactoring__explain_refactoring_rationale
description: Provides an educational breakdown of why a particular refactoring is beneficial, detailing best practices, potential side effects, and performance implications. Main inputs include the specific code change or pattern being evaluated and the target audience's expertise level.

name: mcp__mcp-python-refactoring__validate_python_syntax
description: Checks a given Python code snippet for syntax errors, import issues, and common logical pitfalls before refactoring is applied. Main inputs are the raw code string and a boolean flag indicating whether to include PEP 8 compliance warnings.

name: mcp__mcp-python-refactoring__get_refactoring_examples
description: Retrieves curated examples of similar refactoring patterns from established Python libraries or standard practices to guide the implementation. Main inputs include a keyword description of the refactoring type (e.g., 'list comprehension', 'context manager') and the preferred output format.

name: mcp__memory__memory_write
description: Persistently stores a new piece of information or fact into the knowledge graph. The main input is a text string containing the statement to be added, optionally accompanied by keywords or entities to facilitate indexing and future retrieval.

name: mcp__memory__memory_read
description: Retrieves relevant facts from the persistent knowledge graph based on a semantic query. The main input is a search query string that specifies the topic or context, returning connected nodes and related factual statements.

name: mcp__memory__memory_delete
description: Removes a specific fact or relationship from the memory system to ensure accuracy and reduce noise. The main input is the unique identifier of the node or statement to be deleted, confirming its removal from the graph structure.

name: mcp__mercado-libre__search_products
description: Searches for products available on Mercado Libre based on specific query parameters such as keyword, price range, condition, and seller location. Returns a list of matching product listings with key details like ID, title, price, and shipping options.

name: mcp__mercado-libre__get_product_details
description: Retrieves comprehensive information for a specific Mercado Libre product using its unique item ID. Inputs include the item ID and optionally an access token, returning details such as description, specifications, seller info, and available variations.

name: mcp__mercado-libre__create_order
description: Creates a new purchase order on Mercado Libre for a specified buyer. Requires inputs including the item ID, quantity, buyer credentials (access token), and shipping method to process the transaction and return the order details.

name: mcp__mercado-libre__get_order_details
description: Fetches detailed information about an existing Mercado Libre order using its unique order ID. Inputs include the order ID and access token, returning status, payment info, shipping data, and associated items.

name: mcp__mercado-libre__search_sellers
description: Searches for sellers on Mercado Libre based on criteria such as nickname, location, or reputation level. Returns a list of seller profiles including their ID, name, and performance metrics relevant to buyer trust.

name: mcp__mercado-libre__get_seller_details
description: Retrieves detailed profile information for a specific Mercado Libre seller using their user ID. Inputs include the seller ID and optionally an access token, returning data on their reputation, sales history, and store preferences.

name: mcp__mercado-pago__create_preference

name: mcp__mercado-pago__get_payment_status
description: Retrieves the current status and details of a specific payment transaction initiated via the marketplace. Main input is the unique payment ID or preference ID associated with the transaction.

name: mcp__mercado-pago__list_purchases

name: mcp__mercado-pago__cancel_preference
description: Cancels an existing payment preference to prevent further checkout attempts before a payment is completed. Main input is the unique ID of the preference to be cancelled.

name: mcp__metabase__query_database

name: mcp__metabase__get_dashboard_cards

name: mcp__metabase__execute_card_query

name: mcp__miro-remote__create_diagram

name: mcp__miro-remote__list_board_elements

name: mcp__miro-remote__search_board_content

name: mcp__miro-remote__get_document_details
description: Fetches the metadata and content of a specific document attached to or embedded in a Miro board. The main input is the unique document or object ID.

name: mcp__miro-remote__update_diagram_element
description: Modifies properties (such as position, color, size, or text) of an existing element within a diagram on a Miro board. The main inputs are the target object ID and the updated property values.

name: mcp__miro-remote__manage_board_permissions
description: Retrieves or updates the access rights for users collaborating on a specific Miro board workspace. The main inputs are the board ID, user identifiers, and the desired permission level (e.g., view, edit).

name: mcp__morningstar-mcp-server__get_company_overview
description: Retrieves basic information for a specific company or ETF, including its Morningstar rating and sector classification. Inputs include the unique Morningstar ticker (ticker) and optionally a region to specify the market context.

name: mcp__morningstar-mcp-server__get_market_analysis
description: Delivers broad market analysis data, including index performance and macroeconomic indicators. Inputs include the specific index ticker or market region to retrieve current valuation metrics and historical performance trends.

name: mcp__morningstar-mcp-server__get_investment_data
description: Fetches key quantitative investment data such as price-to-earnings ratios, dividend yields, and net asset values. Inputs include the target ticker and specific financial fields to filter the returned dataset for relevant metrics.

name: mcp__morningstar-mcp-server__search_securities
description: Searches Morningstar's database for securities matching a specific name or keyword. Inputs include the search query string to identify potential investment targets across global markets.

name: mcp__n8n__execute_workflow
description: Executes a specific n8n workflow by providing its ID and optional input parameters. The main inputs are the workflow_id to target and a JSON object containing the data to pass into the workflow's start node.

name: mcp__n8n__get_available_nodes

name: mcp__n8n__search_workflow_templates
description: Searches the library of pre-built n8n workflow templates based on keywords or use cases. The main inputs are search_query terms and optional tags like 'automation', 'data_sync', or 'ai_integration'.

name: mcp__n8n__create_workflow_from_template
description: Clones an existing n8n workflow template to create a new, editable workflow instance. The main inputs are the source_template_id and optional metadata such as a new_name or description for the copied workflow.

name: mcp__nasdaq-data-link__get_economic_data
description: Retrieves specific economic indicators or time-series data from the Nasdaq Data Link database. It primarily accepts a dataset ID (such as 'FRED/GDP') and optional parameters like start_date, end_date, and frequency to filter the results.

name: mcp__nasdaq-data-link__search_datasets
description: Searches the Nasdaq Data Link catalog for available datasets matching specific keywords or categories. It takes a query string and optional filters such as provider, category, or tags to narrow down the list of potential data sources.

name: mcp__nasdaq-data-link__get_dataset_metadata
description: Returns detailed metadata and description for a specific dataset identified by its unique ID. This tool helps users understand the context, units, frequency, and source of the data before downloading it.

name: mcp__nasdaq-data-link__download_dataset
description: Fetches the raw data (typically in CSV or JSON format) for a specified dataset. It requires the dataset ID and allows filtering by date range, transformation parameters, or column selection to customize the output file.

name: mcp__nasdaq-data-link__get_available_frequencies
description: Lists the available update frequencies (e.g., daily, weekly, monthly) for a specific dataset. This helps users determine how often the data is refreshed and select the appropriate granularity for their analysis.

name: mcp__nasdaq-data-link__list_providers
description: Returns a list of data providers available on Nasdaq Data Link, optionally filtered by industry or country. It helps users identify which organizations supply specific types of financial or economic data.

name: mcp__needle-mcp__search_documents
description: Performs a semantic search across stored documents to retrieve relevant context based on a query string and optional filters.

name: mcp__needle-mcp__index_document

name: mcp__needle-mcp__get_source_content
description: Retrieves the full raw text or specific chunks of a document identified by its unique ID after an initial search.

name: mcp__needle-mcp__list_available_documents
description: Returns a metadata list of all documents currently indexed in the service, including IDs and modification dates.

name: mcp__neo4j-cloud-aura-api__create_database
description: Creates a new Neo4j Aura database instance within the specified deployment, accepting parameters such as region, edition, and size. The tool returns the unique identifier and status of the newly provisioned instance.

name: mcp__neo4j-cloud-aura-api__delete_database
description: Deletes an existing Neo4j Aura database instance identified by its ID, optionally triggering a backup before removal. It confirms the deletion request and provides the final status of the operation.

name: mcp__neo4j-cloud-aura-api__get_database_status
description: Retrieves the current configuration and health status of a specific Neo4j Aura database instance using its ID. This includes details such as CPU usage, memory utilization, and connection endpoints.

name: mcp__neo4j-cypher__execute_cypher_query
description: Executes a provided Cypher graph query against the Neo4j database. It takes the query string as input and returns the result set, node properties, and relationship details.

name: mcp__neo4j-cypher__get_node_schema
description: Retrieves the schema information for specific node labels, including their properties and constraints. It requires a list of label names as input to describe the structure of nodes in the graph.

name: mcp__neo4j-cypher__get_relationship_schema
description: Retrieves the schema information for relationship types, including their directionality and property definitions. It takes a list of relationship type names as input to describe how entities connect in the graph.

name: mcp__neo4j-cypher__validate_cypher_query
description: Validates the syntax and semantics of a Cypher query without executing it against the database. It accepts the Cypher string as input and returns any compilation errors or warnings.

name: mcp__neo4j-cypher__list_database_nodes

name: mcp__neo4j-cypher__list_database_relationships
description: Lists the distinct relationship types present in the current Neo4j database instance. It takes no inputs and returns a collection of relationship type strings defined in the graph.

name: mcp__neo4j-data-modeling__create_graph_model
description: Creates a new graph data model definition by specifying node labels, relationship types, and initial schema constraints provided in the input JSON structure.

name: mcp__neo4j-data-modeling__validate_graph_model
description: Validates the structural integrity and correctness of an existing graph data model against defined rules, returning any errors or warnings found in the submitted model definition.

name: mcp__neo4j-data-modeling__visualize_graph_model
description: Generates a visual representation or Mermaid diagram code for a given graph data model to assist in understanding the relationships and structure of the nodes and edges.

name: mcp__neo4j-memory__store_memory
description: Creates or updates a node in the Neo4j graph database to persist specific information, such as code context, project details, or conversation history. It accepts parameters for the entity name, key-value properties to store, and an optional relationship type to link it to existing nodes.

name: mcp__neo4j-memory__query_memory
description: Executes a Cypher query against the Neo4j database to retrieve stored information based on specific criteria or patterns. It takes a Cypher string as input and returns the matching nodes, relationships, or path data relevant to the current coding context.

name: mcp__neo4j-memory__delete_memory
description: Removes specified nodes and/or relationships from the Neo4j graph database to clean up outdated or irrelevant memory entries. name: mcp__neo4j-memory__get_memory_graph
description: Retrieves a subgraph of interconnected memory nodes starting from a given seed node or set of properties. It returns the structure of related entities, helping Claude Code understand contextual dependencies between different pieces of stored information.

name: mcp__neo4j-memory__check_neo4j_connection
description: Verifies the connectivity and health of the Neo4j database instance by executing a simple ping or status check. It returns a boolean success status and any error messages if the connection fails, ensuring the memory backend is available before attempting complex operations.

name: mcp__novita__novita_generate_image

name: mcp__npm-sentinel__check_dependency_risks

name: mcp__octagon__search_market_intelligence

name: mcp__octagon__query_financial_data

name: mcp__okta-mcp-fctr__list_okta_users

name: mcp__okta-mcp-fctr__search_okta_logs

name: mcp__onlyoffice-docspace__upload_file_to_room

name: mcp__onlyoffice-docspace__get_room_details
